set.body: Under CI's setting (tlFatalWarnings := true), main does not compile its test sources: corpus-intake MigrationSuite.scala:94,107,142 discard Boolean from Files.deleteIfExists (E175), on main since 6fe6b26a. A second instance (unused ReadOperation import in embed-bench NfrdBaseballSuite, from 92e1ae78) was fixed in 29e85a0c. Local gates run without fatal warnings, so this went unseen. Acceptance: sbt 'set ThisBuild / tlFatalWarnings := true' compileAll testAll exits 0 on main; then consider making local checkAll use the CI setting so this cannot recur silently.
set.title: [maintenance] main fails CI's fatal-warnings build in test sources (MigrationSuite E175)
